links.outcome: Alignment of ChatGPT BPPV answers with AAO-HNSF guidelines, graded 1-4 by two otolaryngologists
links.effect: 12 of 14 responses fully guideline-aligned (grade 4/4); 2 accurate but lacking detail on fall risk in older persons (grade 3/4); English and French responses uniform.
links.quote: The 2 other responses, although accurate, lacked detail on the risk of falls in older persons with BPPV (grade 3/4).

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's baseline accuracy in providing patient education for BPPV across English and French without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
